tactical_thesis: Keep Melantha through the second artillery projectile's birth, then withdraw her before its fixed-point impact. Deploy Steward afterward and place Ansel at [5,6] DOWN. This confines subsequent artillery splash to the eastern medical/output pair, excluding Spot and Friston. Advance Hibiscus's boosts to 74/124 seconds and reserve Spot's first healing window for 111–136 seconds. Retain eastern Steward through late approach fire, restore Melantha's central damage, and clear both western restraints with separate returning operators. This is an unsimulated, current-model-checkable full-stage hypothesis.
